finding: While pregnancies with diabetes had higher rates of preterm delivery, CS, and LGA infants compared to those without diabetes, the study found that a specialized care model may have contributed to improved maternal and fetal outcomes in GDM, with rates of CS, preterm delivery, and LGA comparable to PDM (except for a higher prevalence of LGA in T1DM).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in pregnancies with diabetes, and the type of diabetes and gestational week were associated with CS rates.
